evals.name: extension-story
evals.prompt:
Analyze this user story. It's for our Android trading app (sniper-v2-android).

# Custom Time Frame

Let users add custom durations to the chart timeframe picker. Today the DurationSelectionBottomSheet shows ~20 fixed durations (1m, 5m, 1h, etc.) from ChartDurationModel in marketpulse-android-sdk. We want users to add their own.

## Acceptance criteria (Android)
- Tap 'Add custom' chip in the duration sheet opens a configurator.
- User picks a base unit (seconds/minutes/hours/days) and a value (e.g. 7 minutes).
- On save, the new custom duration is auto-applied to the chart — no separate select step.
- Custom durations persist per user and appear as chips alongside built-in ones.
- Tapping any existing custom chip re-applies it to the chart (same flow as a built-in duration).
- Show 'Edit' / 'Delete' on long-press of a custom chip.

## Acceptance criteria (Desktop)
- Custom durations sync across the 4 chart panes (multi-monitor mode).
- Hotkey Ctrl+Shift+D opens the custom-duration creator.
- Custom durations show in the right-click context menu of any chart.

## Acceptance criteria (iOS)
- iOS picker UI should match the existing duration picker style.
- Use SwiftUI sheet, not UIKit modal.

## Notes
- Backend: need to confirm if the existing /history endpoint accepts arbitrary duration values or only the predefined enum.
- Compliance: NSE/BSE market-hours rules still apply.
evals.expected_output: HTML doc with: (a) extension story detected, (b) scope-report stripping desktop+iOS sections, (c) backend conditionally included because story mentions endpoint, (d) flow-trace pointing at DurationSelectionBottomSheet + ChartDurationModel + the marketpulse SDK, (e) every question has 3-4 options + 1 Recommended.

evals.name: new-feature-story
evals.prompt:
Analyze this user story for our Android trading app.

# Watchlist Group Sharing

Let users share a watchlist group with another user in-app. This is a brand-new feature; nothing similar exists in the app today.

## Acceptance criteria
- User taps 'Share' on a watchlist group.
- Show share sheet: 'In-app share' or 'Copy link'.
- In-app share asks for recipient's username (we have a user-search API).
- Recipient gets a notification with accept/reject.
- On accept, recipient gets a copy of the watchlist (not live-linked; one-time snapshot).
- Sender sees delivery status (sent / accepted / rejected).

## Notes
- Privacy: shared watchlist contains only symbols, no user portfolio data.
- Rate limit: max 10 shares per user per day to prevent spam.
evals.expected_output: HTML doc where Phase 0.5 flow-trace is SKIPPED (not an extension story). Questions still ship with option pills + Recommended. Domain questions cover rate-limit edge cases. No desktop/iOS sections to strip.

evals.name: backend-conditional-story
evals.prompt:
Analyze this user story.

# Order Tag Filters

Add tag filters to the order history screen so users can find their tagged orders fast.

## Acceptance criteria (Android)
- Show a filter chip row above the order list.
- Tapping a chip filters orders by that tag (tags already exist on orders today).
- Multi-select chips (chips can be combined with AND logic).
- Save the last-used filter set in shared prefs.
- New backend endpoint: /orders/by-tags accepting a list of tag IDs (we don't have this today).

## Acceptance criteria (Web)
- Same filter UI as Android but in the web app.

## Notes
- The 'tags' feature already ships; users tag orders via long-press on an order row.
- Backend needs a new endpoint because the current /orders endpoint doesn't support tag filtering server-side.
evals.expected_output: HTML doc with: (a) extension story detected (tags already ship), (b) flow-trace of existing tag plumbing, (c) scope-report stripping web sections, (d) backend section INCLUDED with reason 'Android requires new endpoint /orders/by-tags', (e) questions with option pills.
